title: On Hanging the lamps along the north wall
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：hang　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hang 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the researcher ① hung the lamps along the north wall in the rain, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② hangs the lamps along the north wall without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hang the lamps along the north wall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hung the lamps along the north wall before — a line in the paper for February 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hanging the lamps along the north wall in the rain, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hang from the beam for many years without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hang from the beam for many years at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ hangs from the beam for many years in the rain every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hung the lamps along the north wall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hang the lamps along the north wall, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody hangs the lamps along the north wall without complaint again and somebody must hang the lamps along the north wall in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 悬挂（一般过去式 hung the lamps along the north wall：1966 年研究员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 悬挂（一般现在 hangs the lamps along the north wall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 悬挂（不定式 to hang the lamps along the north wall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 悬挂（过去完成时 had hung the lamps along the north wall：1960 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 悬挂（动名词 hanging the lamps along the north wall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 垂着（hang from the beam for many years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去垂着在梁上垂了许多年）
G. v. 垂着（hang from the beam for many years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 悬挂（后段两处：新来的学生照例 hangs from the beam for many years，而母亲又一次 hung the lamps along the north wall）

answers.why: hang 意为“悬挂”，1966 年研究员淋着雨悬挂把灯挂在北墙上，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hung。
hang 意为“悬挂”，自那以后研究员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hangs。
hang 意为“悬挂”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯悬挂把灯挂在北墙上”，此处为不定式 to hang the lamps along the north wall。
hang 意为“悬挂”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人悬挂过，故用过去完成时 had hung。
hang 意为“悬挂”，研究员说“悬挂把灯挂在北墙上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hanging the lamps along the north wall 作主语。
hang 意为“垂着”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去垂着在梁上垂了许多年”，should ever 之后用原形 hang from the beam for many years。
hang 意为“垂着”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻垂着在梁上垂了许多年（hang from the beam for many years at once），以后再也不要提起。
hang 意为“悬挂”，新来的学生每个学期都照例垂着在梁上垂了许多年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hangs。
hang 意为“悬挂”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨悬挂把灯挂在北墙上，用一般过去式 hung 叙述。
hang 意为“悬挂”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要悬挂把灯挂在北墙上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，研究员淋着雨悬挂把灯挂在北墙上；实验室里每一个学生都说这是头一回。（hung the lamps along the north wall）
多年以后，研究员仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（hangs the lamps along the north wall）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯悬挂把灯挂在北墙上这件事本身。（to hang the lamps along the north wall）
早在 1960 年就有人悬挂把灯挂在北墙上，二月那天研究报告上的一行字就是证据。（had hung the lamps along the north wall）
研究员说过，淋着雨悬挂把灯挂在北墙上这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（hanging the lamps along the north wall 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻垂着在梁上垂了许多年，以后再也不要提起。（hang from the beam for many years，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hang 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the researcher hung the lamps along the north wall in the rain, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher hangs the lamps along the north wall without complaint whenever the lab asks.
Hanging the lamps along the north wall in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hang from the beam for many years without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab hangs from the beam for many years in the rain every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hung the lamps along the north wall again, and the lab remembered that half.
